data: In fiscal 2024, Tesla reported revenue of $97,690 million, gross profit of $17,450 million and income from operations of $7,076 million. That works out to a gross margin of about 17.9% (17,450 / 97,690) and an operating margin of about 7.2% (7,076 / 97,690). Both were lower than in fiscal 2023, when revenue was $96,773 million, gross profit was $17,660 million (a 18.2% margin) and operating income was $8,891 million (a 9.2% margin). Revenue rose roughly 1% in 2024, while operating income fell about 20%, reflecting higher operating expenses of $10,374 million versus $8,769 million, including $684 million of restructuring and other charges.
